item.title: ‘Stunning’: Experts attribute USCD remedial math surge to DEI, poor teaching methods
item.description: A recent University of California San Diego faculty report shows a 30-fold spike in freshmen needing remedial math classes alongside a sharp decline in writing skills since 2020. Experts told The College Fix the crisis stems from a mix of pandemic disruptions, the abandonment of standardized testing, poor teaching methods, and a focus on equity […]

item.title: Biggest issue with UMich coach’s adultery is potential racism, race hustlers say
item.description: The University of Michigan fired its head football coach for adultery. Some worry about racist backlash.

item.title: Anti-Turning Point USA professor used class time to plot disruption: report
item.description: Critical race theory Professor Nicole Rousseau used class time to organize a protest of Turning Point USA at a Purdue campus.

item.title: ‘Power Rainbow’ by Harvard grad students teaches 3rd graders about systemic oppression
item.description: Two Harvard graduate students created the "Power Rainbow" tool to educate elementary children about systemic oppression. One is the recipient of a taxpayer-funded scholarship intended to support public service.

item.title: Illinois amends ‘minority teachers’ scholarship to end federal lawsuit
item.description: Illinois Governor JB Pritzker signed legislation to end illegal racial discrimination against white students.

item.title: Students at UGA speak out in support of free speech
item.description: We asked students at the University of Georgia if they support free speech. The students we spoke to all agreed.

item.title: More TV shows should portray Christians as being ok with abortion: UCSF researcher
item.description: A UCSF study found that few TV shows in 2025 depicted Christians as accepting of abortion. And that's a problem, according to the lead researcher.

item.title: AI teaching tool used at 32 colleges raises $1.1M to expand, boost student engagement
item.description: An artificial intelligence platform aimed at assisting educators with various tasks has raised $1.1 million to scale its operations across the U.S. “CampusKnot’s AI-powered tools simplify participation, provide real-time feedback, and eliminate the manual effort of tracking engagement, making every classroom more interactive and efficient,” according to the platform’s website. item.title: Debate about removing Confederate memorial resurfaces at Trinity College
item.description: A Trinity College student reignited debate over a Confederate memorial plaque, arguing for its removal due to its association with historical oppression.

item.description: 'It is a very intense investigation, it's complex.'
